title: Fisheries Phase Diagram for Status Declaration of Stocks With Fluctuating Population Dynamics
content:
ABSTRACT

Fish stocks are in a continuum between smooth and fluctuating population dynamics. The Kobe plot is a graphical standard widely used for status declaration with respect to MSY-based biological reference points (BRP). However, these BRP are inadequate for stocks with fluctuating dynamics. Their use leads to abrupt shifts from sustainable to overfished-overfishing even when abundance is long-term non-declining. A more general phase diagram, built with BRP from the mean latent productivity (MLP$$ \mathrm{MLP} $$), leads to sustainable status in four stocks of small pelagic fish and octopus that have fluctuating yet non-declining abundance. Conversely, the Kobe plot portraits them abruptly switching between sustainable and overfished-overfishing status. In a fifth stock with smooth dynamics, MSY−$$ \mathrm{MSY}- $$ and MLP−based$$ \mathrm{MLP}-\mathrm{based} $$ diagrams produce the same status. Complementing previous recommendations to set harvest rates of stocks with fluctuating dynamics at the MLP$$ \mathrm{MLP} $$, we recommend that status declaration of these stocks be made with MLP-based BRP in phase diagrams.
